items.title: FSSAI seizes food items worth  ₹81.8 crore, suspends over 1,100 licences in two-month enforcement drive
items.excerpt: The food safety regulator said it had inspected 56,431 establishments and issued 10,047 improvement notices from September 1 to November 5 as part of the drive.

items.title: Netanyahu rival Eisenkot to be tasked with forming new government following Israeli elections
items.excerpt: In Israel, a candidate tasked with forming a new government has 28 days to carry out the job. The president is able to extend this by a maximum of 14 days before giving the mandate to someone else.
